hero.title: Clarity to create, share, and care for your work.
hero.description: Here we bring together a general explanation of the legal topics Storativa is preparing for its public launch.

notice.title: Information to guide you
notice.description: This section is not Storativa's privacy notice or terms and conditions. It does not replace advice from a qualified legal professional for your particular situation.

topics.title: See how these topics relate to Storativa.
topics.description: Legal information should be understandable. That is why we organize the aspects you will usually need to review before using or sharing content on the platform.

use.title: Using the platform
use.description: Understand the general rules for creating an account, using Storativa's tools, and helping keep a respectful space for every user.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.description: Learn which aspects to review regarding the handling of your personal data, account security, and communications related to the service.

authorship.title: Content and authorship
authorship.description: Learn about the criteria that apply to the stories and materials you add, including third-party rights and responsible use of content.

consultation.title: What you can review in the legal documents.
consultation.description: Storativa's legal documents should help you make informed decisions when using the service. Look especially for information about:

items.terms: The conditions for accessing and using Storativa's tools.
items.data: How your personal data is handled and protected.
items.content: Your responsibilities when creating, uploading, or sharing content.
items.account: Managing your account, security, and important service notices.

support.title: Do you have a question about these topics?
support.description: Review the applicable documents before using a feature or sharing a work. If your situation requires a specific legal interpretation, we recommend consulting a qualified legal professional in your jurisdiction.
